verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, since a buyer could ask about on-premises or self-run deployment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows AWS letting users run its core platform on their own infrastructure. The open-source CDK, the open-source MCP servers and the note that agent code 'runs on your laptop' are client-side tools or user code, not self-hosting of the core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
